observed_value: principal_amount_usd is blank on FX01 issue rows for non-USD debt principal
anchor_value: source schedule shows EUR-denominated Par/Shares requiring explicit USD principal conversion

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Albion Fortress Intermediate Holdings LLC | First Lien - Term Loan | EURIBOR + 575 | 7.8 | 7/31/2031 | EUR | 23,474,732 | 26,175 | 26,591 | 2.6

findings.detail: Non-USD debt par is present in the source schedule, but the extracted holding leaves principal_amount_usd blank instead of carrying an explicit USD conversion for par analytics.

rationale: FX01 is a real data error. The queue rows identify blank principal_amount_usd for non-USD debt principal, and the raw source schedule confirms at least one matching debt position with EUR-denominated Par/Shares: Albion Fortress Intermediate Holdings LLC first lien term loan, EURIBOR + 575, Par/Shares EUR 23,474,732. Because the source principal is non-USD and no USD principal amount is stored, the extracted row lacks the explicit FX-converted principal required by the rule.
